cards:
extractEmails — List the email addresses written somewhere in a text.
  needs: text: string
  optional: unique: boolean
  e.g. "get the emails out of this: contact ana@example.com or sales@shop.co.uk" → {"text":"contact ana@example.com or sales@shop.co.uk"}

extractUrls — List the web addresses appearing in a block of text.
  needs: text: string
  optional: unique: boolean
  e.g. "get the links from: see https://example.com/docs and www.other.org" → {"text":"see https://example.com/docs and www.other.org"}

extractHeadings — Pull the heading structure out of a markdown document as a plain outline.
  needs: markdown: string
  e.g. "get the headings out of this markdown" → {"markdown":"# Title

Some text.

## Section one

## Section two"}

generateTableOfContents — Build a linked table of contents to sit at the top of a document.
  needs: markdown: string
  optional: maxLevel: integer, numbered: boolean
  e.g. "make a table of contents for this markdown" → {"markdown":"# Title

Some text.

## First part

## Second part

### A detail"}

markdown.label: markdown
markdown.prompt: Which Markdown should I build a contents list from?

cards:
findLongSentences — Spot the sentences that run on past a word limit.
  needs: text: string
  optional: threshold: integer
  e.g. "find the long sentences in this" → {"text":"This is short. This sentence, on the other hand, goes on for a considerable length and contains a great many words indeed.","threshold":15}

findRepeatedWords — Spot a word used again too soon after itself.
  needs: text: string
  optional: window: integer, minLength: integer
  e.g. "find repeated words in this text" → {"text":"The report says the report is late because the report was delayed."}

window.label: max words apart
window.description: how close two uses have to be to count as a repeat

cards:
findLongestWord — Find the longest word in a text — the biggest word, and any that tie with it.
  needs: text: string
  optional: top: integer
  e.g. "what is the longest word in this sentence" → {"text":"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"}

wordFrequency — Which words repeat most in a text — each distinct word ranked by how often it recurs.
  needs: text: string
  optional: limit: integer, removeStopWords: boolean
  e.g. "what words come up most in this text" → {"text":"the cat sat on the mat the cat purred","limit":2}

generateSchedule — Divide a stretch of time into even slots, with optional breaks between them.
  needs: start: string, end: string
  optional: slots: integer, slotMinutes: integer, breakMinutes: integer
  e.g. "split 9am to noon into three slots" → {"start":"09:00","end":"12:00","slots":3}

timeBlockSchedule — Lay tasks out as time blocks through the day, with breaks between them.
  needs: tasks: array, start: string
  optional: breakMinutes: integer
  e.g. "block out my morning" → {"tasks":[{"task":"writing","minutes":90},{"task":"email","minutes":30},{"task":"review","minutes":60}],"start":"09:00","breakMinutes":15}

slots.label: number of slots
slots.description: how many slots to divide the time into

slotMinutes.label: slot length (minutes)
slotMinutes.description: how long each slot should be

tasks.label: tasks
tasks.prompt: Which tasks, and how long does each take?

cards:
urlEncode — Percent-escape text so it survives inside a web address.
  needs: text: string
  optional: scope: string
  e.g. "url encode "hello world"" → {"text":"hello world"}

splitEvenly — Split an amount into equal parts, assigning the leftover pennies so the parts add back up.
  needs: amount: number, parts: integer
  optional: decimals: integer
  e.g. "split 100 three ways" → {"amount":100,"parts":3}

pickRandom — Pick one or more items at random from a list, from a seed so the pick can be repeated.
  needs: items: array, seed: integer
  optional: count: integer, allowRepeats: boolean
  e.g. "pick one of these at random with seed 7" → {"items":["tea","coffee","water"],"seed":7}

randomNumber — Pick a random number in a range, from a seed so the same draw can be repeated.
  needs: min: number, max: number, seed: integer
  optional: count: integer, whole: boolean, unique: boolean
  e.g. "pick a number between 1 and 100 with seed 7" → {"min":1,"max":100,"seed":7}
